bio: This bolthole in historic Lyon ticks all the boxes: a trendy chummy vibe and a ubiquitous decor of exposed beams and stonework. The food demonstrates a clever, creative slant with uninhibited dishes to share depicted by mussels, curry and dried lime, an exuberant new take on blanquette of veal or stuffed cabbage. Beware: it may well become your new HQ....
